security_audit.summary: The eval example, predictable shared temporary paths, and unsanitized CSV-derived filenames create code execution or file-clobbering risks. Other matches are Markdown formatting, documented installation commands, dependency checks, or expected PDF file operations. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Invoice generation evaluates CSV content as Python code.
remediation.suggestion: Replace eval with json.loads and define the expected JSON format. Validate item fields and types before generating invoices.

remediation.issue: OCR and size-check examples use predictable paths under /tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Use tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile or TemporaryDirectory with unique names. Keep file handles controlled and clean up in a finally block.

remediation.issue: Invoice numbers are used directly in generated output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only a restricted filename character set. Resolve the destination and verify that it remains inside the selected output directory.

content.value_statement: PDF work often requires different tools for extraction, editing, OCR, and generation. This skill provides focused workflows and library guidance for common PDF tasks.
actual_capabilities: Extract text with basic or layout-aware methods.
Merge, split, rotate, and reorder PDF pages.
Create reports, invoices, and image-based PDF documents.
Fill forms, add annotations, and modify metadata.
Run OCR workflows for scanned documents.
limitations: It provides guidance and helper scripts, not a hosted PDF processing service.
OCR accuracy depends on scan quality, language data, and installed system dependencies.
Encrypted PDFs require authorized passwords and compatible library support.
Large or malformed PDFs can require additional memory limits and input validation.

use_cases.title: Extract report data
use_cases.description: Extract text and tables from business reports for review or downstream analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare document batches
use_cases.description: Merge, split, watermark, and rotate PDFs in repeatable Python workflows.

use_cases.title: Create accessible scans
use_cases.description: Apply OCR to scanned documents and create searchable PDF output.

prompt_templates.title: Extract text from a PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me extract readable text from document.pdf using Python. Explain the required library and save the result to a text file.

prompt_templates.title: Merge selected files
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me a safe Python workflow to merge these PDF files in order: contract.pdf, appendix.pdf, and exhibits.pdf. Save the result as combined.pdf.

prompt_templates.title: Extract invoice tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me extract tables from invoices.pdf with pdfplumber. Include checks for pages without tables and export the results for review.

prompt_templates.title: Build a secure OCR workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Python OCR workflow for scanned PDFs. Use unique temporary files, validate input paths, clean up resources, and produce a searchable output PDF.

output_examples.input: Extract tables from a quarterly report PDF.
output: Workflow: open the document, inspect each page, extract detected tables, and review missing pages.
Result: structured rows ready for export or analysis.

output_examples.input: Split a large PDF into smaller files.
output: Workflow: read pages sequentially, write each output part to a selected directory, and close writers after use.
Result: numbered PDF parts with the requested page grouping.

output_examples.input: Create a searchable copy of a scanned PDF.
output: Workflow: render pages, run OCR, add a text layer, and remove temporary artifacts.
Result: a searchable PDF that retains the original visual pages.

best_practices: Validate PDF inputs and output locations before processing.
Use unique, managed temporary files and remove them after processing.
Close PDF documents and process large files in chunks to control memory use.
anti_patterns: Do not use eval to parse values from CSV files or other untrusted input.
Do not overwrite source PDFs without an explicit backup or output path.
Do not assume OCR text is accurate without validating important fields.

faq.question: Which library should I use for simple text extraction?
faq.answer: Use pypdf for basic text extraction and page operations.

faq.question: Which library helps with tables?
faq.answer: Use pdfplumber when layout-aware extraction or table detection is needed.

faq.question: Can this skill process scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents OCR workflows using pdf2image and pytesseract.

faq.question: Can it fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes form workflow guidance using PyMuPDF.

faq.question: Does it install system dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: No. Installation commands are examples and require user review and authorization.

faq.question: How should I handle large PDFs?
faq.answer: Process pages in chunks, close resources promptly, and test memory use with representative files.
